guards.rationale: RelicModel.IsAllowedAtNeow(player) is `=> IsAllowed(player.RunState)` (RelicModel.cs:443-446) -- one member with an override point, not two independent gates. The sim has `Relic.is_allowed_at_neow` (relics/base.py:159) and NO is_allowed at all, so this relic's port hard-codes the Neow flag to False to express a gate that C# expresses on IsAllowed. Same observable HERE, which is why this is a divergence and not a gap: both codebases refuse the relic at Neow and everywhere else. But the divergence is a FIX-ORDERING CONSTRAINT worth recording, because it is not obviously safe pool-wide: when the 17-relic `Relic.is_allowed(run)` fix lands (sweep B / relic/lucky_fysh G2 / relic/meal_ticket G2 / relic/molten_egg G1), is_allowed_at_neow must be made to DELEGATE to it, or Neow's filter silently keeps using a stale independent flag. Checked and no relic bites today: the 17 floor-gated relics are all allowed at Neow anyway (TotalFloor is 1 there), silver_crucible and winged_boots gate on `Players.Count == 1` which is true in single-player, and kaleidoscope and scroll_boxes override IsAllowedAtNeow itself. Rule 7: leans on relics/base.py and RelicModel.cs, neither hashed here.
